raffle.title: Prize draws
raffle.heroTitle: Every draw, dem settle am on-chain.
raffle.heroBody: DeHub prize draws dey share DeHub tokens, hardware and collectibles give people wey dey use the platform already. You go get entry by taking part, dem go publish the entry list before the draw, and na transaction wey everybody fit read go pick the winner.
raffle.findLiveDraw: Find the live draw for your feed
raffle.noPurchase: You no need buy anything. Every draw get free way to enter, and if dem sell ticket, e no go ever be the only way.
raffle.anatomyPrizeBody: Dem go talk am when the draw open. Dem no go change am after.
raffle.anatomyRoutesBody: Dem go list all of dem, with how much weight each one carry.
raffle.anatomyClosingBody: Fixed time, no be "when we reach am".
raffle.anatomySnapshotBody: Dem go publish am before dem run the draw.
raffle.anatomyRandomnessBody: Dem draw am on-chain, inside transaction wey you fit open.
raffle.anatomyClaimBody: 14 days from when dem publish the result.
raffle.howBody: Four steps, the same order, every time. The part wey decide who win dey happen for open.
raffle.step1Body: Every draw go open with im prize, im closing time and the exact ways wey you fit take get entry. Dem go post am for the app and pin am for the feed.
raffle.step2Body: You go get entries by doing things wey you dey do on DeHub already. The announcement go list which action count for that draw and how many entries each one worth.
raffle.step3Body: For closing time dem go snapshot the entry list, and dem go draw the winning number from on-chain randomness, no be from spreadsheet.
raffle.step4Body: The snapshot, the transaction and the winning entry go comot together, so anybody fit check the result again instead of to just believe us.
raffle.entriesTitle: Na to earn entry, no be to buy am
raffle.entriesBody: Draws dey favour people wey dey use DeHub. Every announcement go name the ways wey count for am. These ones na the ones wey draws dey mostly use.
raffle.postBody: Your own posts, videos and comments go count for draws wey name dem.
raffle.stakeBody: Staking position wey still dey open go earn you entries for draws wey count am.
raffle.arcadeBody: Arcade games and leaderboard positions dey feed draws wey dem build around games.
raffle.stagesBody: To show face for live audio stages dey count, whether you talk or you just dey listen.
raffle.ticketBody: Some draws dey also sell ticket wey you go pay with DeHub tokens. If dem do am, dem go publish the price and how many one wallet fit buy before-before.
raffle.collectibleBody: Some NFT collections dey carry permanent entries enter draws wey name dem.
raffle.fairnessTitle: Why you fit trust the result
raffle.fairnessBody: Raffle worth to enter only if the person wey dey run am no fit quietly pick the winner. Three things make am so for here.
raffle.fair1Title: Dem go freeze the list first
raffle.fair1Body: Dem go snapshot the entry list for the closing time wey dem talk, and publish am before dem run the draw. Nobody fit add anything after, even us.
raffle.fair2Title: Randomness dey come from the chain
raffle.fair2Body: Dem get the winning number on-chain, so the number wey decide the draw dey inside public transaction, no be inside our own tool.
raffle.fair3Title: You fit check the whole result
raffle.fair3Body: Snapshot, transaction hash and winning entry, dem go publish all of dem together. If you run the calculation again from public data, you go reach the same winner.
raffle.neverPayTitle: DeHub no go ever ask you to pay before you collect prize
raffle.neverPayBody: Dem go name winners for the app and for the public result post. Nobody from DeHub go contact you to ask for fee, seed phrase, private key or wallet signature before dem give you prize. Any message wey do am na fake person. Report am and delete am.
raffle.faqBody: The ones wey people dey ask us pass about draws, entries and prizes.
raffle.faq1Q: I must buy anything before I fit enter DeHub prize draw?
raffle.faqPurchaseAnswer: No. Every draw get at least one free way to enter, wey you go earn by taking part for DeHub. Some draws dey also sell ticket wey you go pay with DeHub tokens, but ticket no ever be the only way to enter.
raffle.faq2Q: How I go know say dem no rig the draw?
raffle.faq2A: Dem go snapshot the entry list and publish am before dem run the draw, and dem go draw the winning number from on-chain randomness. Dem go publish the snapshot, the transaction and the winning entry together, so anybody fit calculate the result again.
raffle.faq3Q: How dem go take tell winners?
raffle.faq3A: Dem go tell winners for the app and name dem for the result post. No email go ask you for payment, seed phrase or wallet signature. DeHub no go ever ask for any of dem before dem release prize.
raffle.faq4Q: How long I get to claim?
raffle.faq4A: Fourteen days from when dem publish the result. Token prizes go land for the winner DeHub wallet on Base. For physical prizes, the team go arrange am with you direct, and we go cover shipping where e legal for us to ship.
raffle.faq5A: Anybody wey get DeHub account, wey pass 18 years and dey live for place wey the draw legal. DeHub staff, contractors and their household no fit enter, and draws no dey valid where local law no allow am.
raffle.faq6Q: How often dem dey run draws?
raffle.faq6A: E no get fixed time. Draws dey follow launches, milestones and partner campaigns, and dem go announce each one for the app when e open.
raffle.ctaBody: Anything wey dey live now, dem go announce am for your feed. On notifications make the next one no pass you.
raffle.legal: Prize draws na for promotion, and na only DeHub account holders wey don reach 18 fit enter; e no valid where local law no allow am. DeHub staff, contractors and their household no fit enter. You no fit change prizes to cash unless dem talk am, and the announcement for each draw carry im full terms.

screens.glossaryDhbTokenDesc: DHB na di ticker symbol for DeHub tokens, di native utility token of DeHub. People dey use am for tipping, pay-per-view content, governance voting, and staking.
screens.glossaryGovernanceDesc: Submit and vote on proposals wey dey shape di platform. Your voting power depend on how many DeHub tokens you hold.
screens.glossaryLeaderboardDesc: We dey rank users by total DeHub token balance (wallet + staked across all chains). Rankings dey update from time to time and dey track 1-day and 1-week changes. You fit also sort by tips wey dem send, tips wey dem receive, followers, likes, or subscribers.
screens.glossaryStakingDesc: Lock your DeHub tokens to earn rewards as time dey go. Tokens wey you stake go also give you more voting power for governance.
screens.glossaryTipDesc: Send DeHub tokens straight to content creator as reward for dem content. We dey record tips on-chain.
screens.glossaryWalletDesc: Your on-chain wallet wey dey hold your DeHub tokens and other crypto assets. E connect through Web3Auth so you fit enter am easy.
screens.freeDmAccessSubtitle: People wey fit message you free
screens.freeDmAccessModalDesc: People wey fit message you free, without paying your message fee.
screens.freeDmGrantHint: Give access from inside DM chat.
screens.glossarySubtitle: Learn wetin every icon and feature mean
screens.glossaryMintTxDesc: Tap the info icon for post wey dem don mint to open im mint transaction for block explorer and check the on-chain record. The full Post Info page — stats, holders, marketplace — dey for the web app for dehub.io.
screens.glossaryTokenIdDesc: One unique on-chain ID wey dem give post when dem mint am as NFT.
screens.glossaryPpvDesc: Premium kontent wey require payment for DeHub tokun tokun to unlock. Kreatas set di price and dem dey earn revenue from each view.
screens.glossaryStakingBadgesDesc: Badges wey dey show for your username base on your total DeHub token wey you hold (wallet + staked). Na 13 levels dem get - the more token you hold, the higher your badge rank go be. Higher levels go give you more power to vote for governance and lower platform fees.

getting-started.intro: Five ways dey to enter DeHub and none of dem need make you don get wallet before: Google, Apple, code wey we send to your email, code wey we send by SMS, or wallet wey you already get wey you connect. Everything except di wallet way go create non-custodial wallet for you for background — na you hold di keys, and DeHub dey pay di gas so you fit post, tip and collect without you buy any native token at all.
getting-started.title: Getting Started

steps.1: Visit dehub.io — di home feed na di front page, so you fit look around before you sign in.
steps.2: Click 'Sign In'. You go see Google and Apple, fields for email address or phone number, and 'Connect Wallet' if you don get wallet before.
steps.5: Pick username. Na wetin people go see, and e be your dehub.io/<username> profile link too.
steps.6: You don enter. Check di feed, set up your profile, and start to post.
steps.3: Wen yu use Google or Apple, complete provider's flow. Wen yu use email or SMS, enter code wey dey arrive.
steps.4: Wallet don create and secure for you wen you sign-in for the first time. When you connect your own wallet, you go need just one sign to prove your address.

tips.1: Social, email and SMS sign-ins no dey pay gas at all — DeHub dey pay am. Connected wallets dey pay dem own ETH or BNB.
tips.3: You fit keep plenty accounts for one device and switch between dem for Settings → Profile.
tips.2: Come back to yor legacy DeHub account? Sign in wit yor email or phone number wey use am before, migration go find am for yor.

depin.title: DePin
depin.threeJobsTitle: One node, three good work for you.
depin.ctaBody: Origin backup, encrypted protected media and work wey dem don check go come first before any public node reward.
depin.ctaTitle: Launch only when e safe if something fail.
depin.earlyAccessBody: Small node wey dey run for browser don dey live for down. Bigger desktop node wey go dey on all the time na plan for future, e never ready. To join no mean say you go surely collect reward.
depin.footerNote: DePin participation na contribution service, e no be investment product. Availability, who fit join and rewards fit change.
depin.heroBlurb: Give your extra storage, bandwidth and compute make e help host, transcode and deliver DeHub content.
depin.heroCaption: DeHub dey keep the main copy. Community nodes dey add strong backup copies and local delivery power.
depin.heroImageAlt: Small edge-compute node wey connect to houses and creator studios
depin.noFixedRate: No fixed rate, no minimum return, no APY and no forecast dey. Contribution records na for accounting only, dem no be promise say we go pay. Any token settlement for future go happen for Base and e go depend on who qualify, network rules and the law wey apply.
depin.nodesLeaveBody: No community machine dey hold the only copy. Health checks, backup copies and origin backup dey make playback dey available.
depin.nodesLeaveTitle: Network wey sabi say nodes go comot.
depin.privacyBody: Protected media dey stay encrypted for community hardware. Dem dey give playback keys separately to viewers wey get permission.
depin.privacyTitle: Hosts dey keep pieces, dem no get access.
depin.runningCosts: To run node dey use light, internet data and hardware life. Operators fit collect nothing, and their cost fit pass any reward.
depin.safestWorkloadBody: DePin dey first support the delivery path wey DeHub get already. Harder work go follow only after dem don prove say checking dey work.
depin.safestWorkloadTitle: We build am from the safest work go outside.
depin.threeJobsBody: Operators dey choose their storage, bandwidth and compute limit. DeHub dey give only the work wey their machine fit carry safely.
depin.transcodeBody: Machines wey qualify dey turn uploaded video to different quality versions. Dem dey check every output before dem fit serve am.
depin.transcodeImageAlt: Creator workstation for house wey dey give extra GPU compute
depin.verifiedWorkBody: Dem dey measure contribution with signed receipts, health checks and output checks. Storage alone no dey bring reward.
depin.verifiedWorkTitle: Dem dey check useful work. Rewards no dey fixed.
depin.hostBody: Nodes dey keep encrypted or content-addressed pieces for small local cache wey get limit. DeHub origin storage still be the main source.
depin.deliverBody: Peers wey dey near dey share video pieces while the normal delivery path dey ready as automatic backup.
depin.originBody: Main source copy wey no dey go and backup delivery
depin.availableReplicasBody: Dey serve checked pieces near where people need am
depin.offlineNodeBody: Dem remove am from routing until e connect again
depin.viewerBody: E dey use peer when e dey, origin when e need am
depin.protectedContentBody: Subscriber, private and pay-per-view pieces fit dey stored as ciphertext. Node operators no dey get access keys just because dem host data.
depin.publicContentBody: Encryption dey stop people from just dey look inside cached files, but people fit still watch public media for the public DeHub player. We no go talk anything different.
depin.operatorControlsBody: Operators dey choose disk limit, bandwidth limit, work hours and the public content categories wey dem allow. Removal notice dey clear the cache.
depin.deliveryReceiptsBody: Checked bytes wey dem serve to real playback sessions.
depin.availabilityBody: Retrieval checks wey pass and service wey dey reliable when dem give am work.
depin.validOutputBody: Transcodes must pass technical checks and quality checks wey dem sample.
depin.revenuePoolBody: If dem start am, reward budget go come from platform revenue after the epoch close.
depin.deliveryBody: Live and video delivery wey peers dey help, with automatic backup.
depin.adaptiveVideoBody: Different quality versions so playback go dey steady for any connection speed.
depin.desktopNodesBody: Storage wey get limit, bandwidth control and availability wey dem don check.
depin.baseSettlementBody: Claims wey revenue dey fund only after operation and legal review.
depin.dhbEarnedThisPeriod: Tokens wey you earn this period
depin.faqOfflineQ: Wetin go happen when hosting node go offline?
depin.faqOfflineA: The coordinator go remove am from active routing. Another copy go serve the piece, or playback go fall back to DeHub origin storage while dem dey arrange new copies.
depin.faqCanOperatorSeeQ: Node operator fit see the content wey e dey host?
depin.faqCanOperatorSeeA: Protected content dey stored as encrypted pieces and the host no dey get playback keys. Public content still dey open for everybody to watch for DeHub, na so dem design am.
depin.faqHowMuchQ: How much node operator go collect?
depin.faqHowMuchA: No fixed rate or forecast dey. Contribution wey dem don check fit get share from reward pool wey revenue dey fund after epoch close. Rewards no dey guaranteed, and light, bandwidth and hardware cost fit pass any reward.
depin.faqSoftwareAvailableQ: Node software don dey available now?
depin.faqSoftwareAvailableA: Small browser-based level dey available today: sign in and opt in for this page, and your open tab go turn node while e still dey open. Bigger desktop node wey go dey on all the time na plan for future — e never exist.
depin.faqInstallNeededQ: I need install anything for the browser node?
depin.faqInstallNeededA: No. E dey run inside the tab with your browser local storage. If you close the tab your node go stop; no background service and no install.
depin.appSignInBlurb: Sign in make you see your node ledger: wetin you don store, wetin dem don check and wetin you earn this period.
depin.appNodeBody: The node dey run for browser tab, no be for this app. Open DePin for web, sign in with this account and opt in. Your ledger go show for here.

premium.diveBackgroundBody: Lock your phone, change app, jump tab — your video and music go still dey play. Use DeHub like di media app wey e be.
premium.diveAiTitle: AI wey you fit really trust
premium.diveAiBody: 500 Assistant messages, 150 AI images, and 20 seconds of video wey AI make every month. E reach to build, ship and post — no be just small taste.
premium.faqWhatIsAnAdA: Promoted posts for your feed, upgrade banners, and sponsored spots for Explore. Premium go comot all of dem.
premium.faqSwitchPlansQ: I fit change between Extra and Family?
premium.faqSwitchPlansA: Yes. Upgrade or downgrade anytime — di billing go balance imsef.
premium.faqFamilySeatsA: Di owner go invite up to 5 DeHub usernames. Each member go keep im own account, badges and quotas — nothing dey shared.
premium.faqTopTierStakerQ: I dey top staking tier. I still go pay?
premium.faqTopTierStakerA: No. Top 7 staking tiers dey get DeHub Extra free. Top 4 tiers dey get DeHub Family free. If you unstake, di perks go comot — stake again and dem go come back.
premium.faqPayInDhbQ: I fit pay with DeHub tokens?

connect.chatgptAddSources: Pick Add sources, then Connect more.
connect.title: Connect DeHub to your AI helper
connect.subtitle: Make ChatGPT or Claude fit enter DeHub — to look posts, read comment gist, search and check profile — just paste di URL wey dey down here inside your helper connector settings.
connect.agentTitle: You wan make e post, vote and reply?
connect.agentBody: Di URL for up na only to read. Create agent and you go get your own connector URL wey get key inside — na di same steps, but di helper go fit post, comment, vote and follow as your agent.
connect.chatgptDevMode: Turn on Developer mode for di connector settings (read di risk notice wey dem show for there).
connect.chatgptComposer: For di "+" menu wey dey di chat box, turn on Developer mode.
connect.nameAndPaste: Call di connector "DeHub" and paste di MCP URL wey dey up.
connect.askToUse: Tell {{app}} make e use DeHub — like: "Show me di posts wey dey trend for DeHub."
connect.claudeEnable: Turn on di connector from Claude chat box, then tell am make e use DeHub.
connect.otherClients: Any other client wey fit work with MCP go work di same way — add your own MCP server and paste di URL wey dey up.
connect.guideIntro: DeHub dey as {{app}} connector wey dem build inside. Turn am on one time and ask {{app}} about DeHub posts, creators and wetin dey trend — straight from di chat.
connect.step1Body: Tap di button wey dey up. {{app}} go open straight for di DeHub connector inside Settings → Connectors.
connect.step2Body: Switch DeHub on and allow access. After dat {{app}} go fit read DeHub public posts, profiles and topics wey dey trend.
connect.step3Title: Start new chat and use am
connect.step3Body: Open new chat and mention DeHub for your prompt — {{app}} go call di connector by itself.
connect.prompt1: Summarise di top 10 posts wey dey trend for DeHub now now.
connect.prompt2: Find posts for DeHub about Bitcoin from di last 24 hours and give me short gist.
connect.prompt3: Check di DeHub profile @satoshi and tell me wetin dem post dis week.
connect.faqFreeA: Yes. Di connector na free. Your {{app}} plan must support connectors.
connect.faqWhatQ: Wetin di DeHub connector fit do?
connect.faqWhatA: Through MCP e fit look DeHub public posts, search topics and check creator profiles. E no dey post for your name.
connect.chatgptFaqAccount: You no need account to read public content through di connector. You go only need DeHub account if you wan post, tip or hold DeHub tokens.
connect.claudeFaqAccount: No. To read public content no need account. You only need DeHub account to post, tip or hold DeHub tokens.

accountDeletion.title: Delete account
accountDeletion.description: Delete your account and your personal data forever
accountDeletion.warning: Dis one go delete your DeHub profile, posts, comments, messages and di wallet backup wey we keep, forever. Save your wallet recovery details and move all your assets comot first. Public blockchain transactions and payment records wey law say make we keep no fit delete. We go hide your profile sharp sharp; di deletion go finish inside 30 days. You no fit undo am.
